hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); mkdir -p .claude; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'mb (card|dashboard) create' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qF -- '--help'; then if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qF '\"id\":' && ! printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qF '\"ok\":false'; then c=$(cat .claude/.history-log-pending 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo $((c+1)) > .claude/.history-log-pending; fi; elif printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qF 'logs/history.jsonl'; then echo 0 > .claude/.history-log-pending; fi

c=$(cat .claude/.history-log-pending 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$c" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then jq -n --arg c "$c" '{decision:"block", reason: ("\($c) card(s)/dashboard(s) were created via `mb card create` / `mb dashboard create` this session, but logs/history.jsonl has not been appended to since. Append the missing entry per CLAUDE.md \"History log\" before finishing (or run: echo 0 > .claude/.history-log-pending, if logging genuinely does not apply here).")}'; else echo '{}'; fi
